title: Earthy Grassy Peruvian Beef Anticuchos
description: A crowd-pleasing Peruvian dish featuring grassy and crisp flavors, made with dashi and a mirepoix base, served as anticuchos in a kazan cauldron.
instructions: Preheat the kazan cauldron over medium high heat.
Thread the beef heart pieces onto skewers.
In a large bowl, whisk together dashi broth, mirepoix mix, parsley, cilantro, lime juice, garlic powder, and smoked paprika.
Add the beef skewers to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Remove the skewers from the marinade and cook in the preheated kazan cauldron for 5 minutes per side.
Serve the anticuchos hot, garnished with additional parsley and cilantro if desired.
Cook the mirepoix mix in the remaining marinade for 5 minutes, stirring frequently.
Serve the mirepoix mix alongside the anticuchos.
